g.text: The agentic side: a ReAct loop over read-only tools
same 5 tools, two hosts: MCP server (Python app) and JS functions + Gemini function calling (website)
- tools only read data: no writes, files or network
- at most 6 reason/act steps per question
- halal / wifi / price come from verified evidence,
never from the model's own knowledge
- website: visitor's own key | Python app: daily cap
